snippet.title: Thousand Hells - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Four heroes descend into hell in a tactical narrative game blending mythology and surrealism. Recruit your team, choose your path, and overcome the trials of the underworlds. Learn more: https://bit.ly/44ZwWjY

Music by Neha Patel: https://www.nehapatelaudio.com/

A new systemic storybook experience from the designers of King of Dragon Pass and Six Ages.
Sign up for the Thousand Hells newsletter:  https://bit.ly/43xLNQA   

Developed by A Sharp and published by Kitfox Games.
